# Yantrakar AS

> Founder-led software company in Stavanger, Norway (since 2020), run by Sandeep Shelke. Software for machines that work together, and private AI that runs inside a company network for data that can't leave the building.

## Pages

- [Home](https://yantrakar.com/): what Yantrakar does
- [Robotics and machine systems](https://yantrakar.com/robotics.html): integration, architecture and performance tuning in C++ and Python for industrial automation
- [Private AI](https://yantrakar.com/private-ai.html): AI inside your network; choosing a model per use case and running it on your hardware
- [About](https://yantrakar.com/about.html): the company and Sandeep Shelke

## Articles

- [Running AI inside your own network: what I see so far](https://yantrakar.com/running-ai-inside-your-network.md) (21 Oct 2026): what runs today on older GPUs, what does not work yet, where to start, and why self-replication makes the network boundary matter more. Markdown with Mermaid diagrams. HTML version: https://yantrakar.com/running-ai-inside-your-network.html
